concepts.gloss_en: Protection (via tzitzit) from the counsel/impurity of the serpent — i.e. from adultery and lewdness

reason_for_human: All three occurrences are in LM 1:7 and express the identical idea: tzitzit protects a person from the serpent's counsel (adultery/lewdness). The third form only appends 'מזהמת הנחש' (from the serpent's impurity) as a parallel apposition to the same phrase — same concept, not a distinct one. No homograph or archetype/generic split is at play.
